name: post_comment
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Add a comment to a Figma file.

name: delete_comment
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Delete a Figma comment.

name: post_comment_reaction
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Add a reaction to a comment.

name: delete_comment_reaction
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Delete a reaction from a comment.

name: post_variables
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Bulk create, update, and delete variables.

name: post_dev_resources
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Bulk create dev resources.

name: put_dev_resources
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Bulk update dev resources.

name: create_dev_resource
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Create a single dev resource link through the official bulk API.

name: delete_dev_resource
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Delete a dev resource link.

name: publish_code_connect
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Publish Code Connect documents to Figma Dev Mode. Also requires FIGHORSE_MCP_CODE_CONNECT=allow.

name: unpublish_code_connect
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Remove Code Connect mappings by node URL and label. Also requires FIGHORSE_MCP_CODE_CONNECT=allow.

name: create_webhook
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Create a webhook.

name: update_webhook
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Update a webhook.

name: delete_webhook
description: WRITE MODE ONLY. Delete a webhook.

name: canvas_apply
description: CANVAS WRITE MODE ONLY. Apply a structured CanvasPlan to a paired local Figma plugin session. Requires FIGHORSE_MCP_MODE=write, FIGHORSE_CANVAS_MODE=write, and yes=true.

name: canvas_upload_asset
description: CANVAS WRITE MODE ONLY. Place an approved local image or SVG asset on the canvas. Requires yes=true and approved asset roots.

name: canvas_undo
description: CANVAS WRITE MODE ONLY. Undo the latest fighorse plugin transaction when no later user/plugin modification conflicts. Requires yes=true.

name: canvas_execute_script
description: CANVAS SCRIPT MODE ONLY. Execute bounded Figma Plugin API JavaScript in the currently paired local file. Requires FIGHORSE_MCP_MODE=write, FIGHORSE_CANVAS_MODE=write, FIGHORSE_CANVAS_SCRIPT=allow, and yes=true.
